name: application-public-notice-card
title: Public Notice Card
description: Formal civic/government notice card with a category badge, date, title, summary, and a read-more link — no author identity.
useWhen: Displaying official government or civic announcements (service interruptions, public hearings, policy updates) on a resident-facing site.
The notice is impersonal and departmental rather than attributed to a named individual.
Distinct from Announcement Feed Item, which is an internal workplace post attributed to a named author with an avatar, rather than an impersonal official notice.
avoidWhen: The post is attributed to a specific person or team member — use Announcement Feed Item instead.
The content isn't a dated, categorized official notice — a plain content card may be simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Category badge and date stay on one row via flex justify-between; the summary wraps normally without a fixed line-clamp so the full notice preview stays readable.
accessibility: The date uses a semantic <time> element with a machine-readable datetime attribute alongside the human-readable label.
"Read full notice" is a real link with descriptive text, not a bare icon or "click here".

variants.title: Public Notice Card
variants.description: A Public Works category notice about a scheduled water service interruption, with date, title, summary, and a read-more link.
accessibility: Date is marked up with <time datetime> for machine readability.

variants.title: Public Notice Card (Dark)
variants.description: The same notice card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Badge, text, and link contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
